name: Listening To Music
overview: Scripture reveals that listening to music is closely connected to worship and spiritual discernment. The Psalms encourage praising the Lord through song and lifting our eyes to God as our help, while Ecclesiastes warns against valuing foolish songs over wise rebuke. True worship, as Jesus teaches, must be in spirit and truth, emphasizing that what we hear should align with God's Word, which brings faith and transforms the mind to discern His perfect will.
